title: The Missing Compliance Class: LLM Graders That Collapse Jailbreak Success, and a Free Check
abstract: arXiv:2610.24872v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Jailbreak evaluations often substitute open-weight 7B to 9B instruction-tuned models as local, deterministic judges for frontier APIs. Holding target models, prompts, responses, and a four-class rubric fixed across eight graders from five organizations, we find that dense 8B and 9B judges collapse compliant responses onto evasion. One assigns compliance zero times in 900 responses while agreeing with our reference judge on 78.0% of items, certifying an unsafe model as safe. This collapse holds across four 900-response corpora, multiplying reported compliance by a factor of 22 to 25 on our primary corpora while non-refusal shifts by 18.0 to 23.0 points. Without the three collapsing graders, compliance varies by 1.7x to 2.8x across all four corpora, whereas post-labelling rubric rulings (+16.3 points) and benchmark choice (15.3 points) still shift non-refusal. translated_title: 缺失的合规类别：坍缩越狱成功评估结果的LLM评分器及一项免费检测方法
translated_abstract: 越狱攻击评估通常采用开放权重的7B至9B指令微调模型作为前沿API的本地、确定性评判器。我们在来自五个组织的八个评分器上固定目标模型、提示词、响应和四类评分标准，发现稠密的8B和9B评判器会将合规响应坍缩归类为规避。其中一个评判器在900个响应中零次判定为合规，同时与参考评判器在78.0%的样本上保持一致，从而将不安全的模型错误认证为安全。这种坍缩现象在四个900响应语料库中均成立，在主要语料库上将报告的合规率放大约22至25倍，同时非拒绝率偏移18.0至23.0个百分点。在剔除三个坍缩评判器后，合规率在所有四个语料库中仍有1.7至2.8倍的变化，而标注后的评分裁决（+16.3个百分点）和基准选择（15.3个百分点）仍会导致非拒绝率偏移。通过统计每类标签计数，可以零成本暴露类别坍缩问题，无需人工参与。
tldr: 本文发现在越狱攻击评估中，常用的开源8B/9B LLM评判器会系统性地将“合规”类别坍缩为“规避”类别，导致不安全模型被误判为安全，而只需统计每类标签计数即可零成本检测这种坍缩问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that commonly used open-weight 8B/9B LLM graders in jailbreak evaluations systematically collapse the "compliance" class into "evasion," falsely certifying unsafe models as safe, and this collapse can be detected at zero cost by simply counting per-class label frequencies.
